def worker():
    yield 1

def worker():
    received = yield 'ready'
    try:
        yield received
    except ValueError:
        yield 'caught'
receiver = worker()
arg0 = None

next(receiver)
receiver.send(None)
arg0 = ValueError('x')

def worker():
    yield 1
receiver = worker()
next(receiver)
